column1: AN  ACT  TO  PROVIDE  FOR  THE  IMPOSITION  OF  AN  ENVIRONMENT
CONSERVATION LEVY ON SPECIFIED ITEMS OWNED BY CONSUMERS, ON
SPECIFIED ITEMS IMPORTED INTO OR MANUFACTURED IN SRI LANKA OR
SPECIFIED SERVICES PROVIDED IN SRI LANKA, WHICH ARE LIKELY TO
HAVE A HARMFUL IMPACT ON THE ENVIRONMENT; TO PROVIDE FOR THE
COLLECTION AND RECOVERY OF SUCH LEVY; AND TO PROVIDE FOR
MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.
